summary: Kerb is a painted median island at a junction, nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Homes 14 to 17 m away on both sides of the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: The line runs along a raised island with hatched markings between traffic lanes; no room to pull out.
drivers.traffic: Busy signed junction on Stanley Terrace.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this stretch; sign 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

sun_shade: Open to sun; tree shade from the north-west.
